mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may inhibit tacrolimus metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition, increasing tacrolimus levels and toxicity risk; additive CNS effects and potential serotonergic complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor tacrolimus drug levels closely, adjust dosing accordingly, and monitor for signs of tacrolimus toxicity (tremor, renal dysfunction, hypertension).
